appDescription.message: Instantly explain selected text with Chrome's on-device AI. Selected text stays on your device.

optionsTagline.message: On-device AI explanations in Chrome, without sending page content to external servers.

statusReadyMessage.message: Select text on a regular web page, then hover over SI to get an explanation.

statusDownloadableMessage.message: Click the button below to let Chrome download and prepare the model. Initial setup may take a few minutes.

statusDownloadingMessage.message: The download continues in Chrome, and this page updates automatically when it finishes.

statusPreparingConnecting.message: Chrome is downloading or installing the model but has not provided a displayable percentage yet. Keep Chrome open.

statusRemainingProgressHint.message: This percentage is based on the content remaining when progress monitoring was reconnected, not the model's total progress.

statusInstallingMessage.message: Chrome reported that the download is complete and is extracting, installing, or loading the model. This status updates automatically.

statusUnsupportedMessage.message: Use Chrome 138 or later and make sure your device meets Chrome's hardware, storage, and region requirements for built-in AI.

statusErrorMessage.message: The on-device model cannot be prepared right now. Try again later.

statusCheckingMessage.message: Checking the Chrome Prompt API and on-device model status…

usageStep1.message: Open a regular web page and select 1–20 Chinese characters or English words.

usageStep2.message: Hover over the SI button near the selection.

usageStep3.message: Read the short explanation, or select “View more” for a detailed explanation.

privacyItem1.message: The extension only passes your selected text to Chrome's on-device model.

privacyItem2.message: The extension requests no host permissions and does not connect to a SnapInsight backend.

privacyItem3.message: Chrome manages the model and performs the initial download.

privacyItem4.message: Chinese generation is currently experimental and quality may vary by Chrome version.

modelRuntimePreparing.message: Chrome is connecting to the local model. Starting or resuming it may take a moment…

modelGenerating.message: The local model received the request and is generating an explanation…

modelResponseSlow.message: The local model is still generating. The first output may take a little longer…

explanationStreaming.message: The explanation is still being generated…

detailHint.message: Select View more to expand a detailed explanation here.

errorServiceUnavailable.message: Chrome's on-device model is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.

errorPromptApiUnavailable.message: This version of Chrome does not provide the Prompt API. Update your browser.

errorModelDownloadRequired.message: Set up Chrome's on-device model before first use.

errorModelDownloading.message: Chrome is downloading the on-device model. Try again when it finishes.

errorDeviceUnsupported.message: This device does not meet Chrome's on-device model requirements.

errorLanguageUnsupported.message: Chrome's on-device model does not currently support the language of this text.

errorQuotaExceeded.message: The on-device model has insufficient capacity. Close other generation tasks and try again.

errorReadinessTimeout.message: Checking the on-device model timed out. Try again.

errorModelStartupTimeout.message: Connecting to the local model timed out. Try again.

errorFirstTokenTimeout.message: The local model did not respond in time. Try again.

errorStreamStalled.message: The on-device model stopped producing output. Try again.

errorRequestCancelled.message: Generation was cancelled. You can try again.

preparationInterrupted.message: Model setup was unexpectedly interrupted. Retry setup.

preparationApiMissing.message: This version of Chrome does not provide the Prompt API. Update your browser and retry.

preparationDeviceUnsupported.message: This device does not meet Chrome's on-device model requirements.

preparationLanguageUnsupported.message: Chrome's on-device model rejected the current language configuration.

preparationQuotaExceeded.message: The on-device model has insufficient capacity. Close other AI sessions and retry.

preparationDownloadFailed.message: The model could not be downloaded or initialized. Check your network and disk space, then retry.

readinessReadFailed.message: Chrome's on-device model status could not be read. Reopen this page.
